integrationPolicy.commonRuntime: Preserve current main UI, server-action transport, tooling and lint rules; merge course platform extensions.
integrationPolicy.courseFeatures: Preserve course/admin code, schema and migrations, skills and tracked configuration.
integrationPolicy.sharedInfrastructure: Better Auth, Drizzle/libSQL client, atomic revision batches, Toss server client, Comwit storage presign and the admin shell are shared with the shop branch; keep them aligned when fixing common bugs.
integrationPolicy.auth: Use main server getMe to client hydrate boundary with the installed authentication implementations.
integrationPolicy.configuration: Preserve course settings as lazy getters following main.
integrationPolicy.bootstrap: Base app-setup/auth-setup and sample Storybook scaffolds are absent from course because those features are implemented; active course stories and main guidance are retained.
